name: Cloth
notes: Woven cotton, wool and linen: curtains, banners, rugs, sacks, bedding. Catches readily (260 °C is a game value between cotton's piloted and auto-ignition points) and burns out in 45 s. Density 600 kg/m³ as a loose bundle, so dry cloth floats. Muffles sound (0.6) and cushions falls (0.5); a rug quiets footsteps by 8 dB. Neither transparent nor opaque: partial cover, as the property spec describes for cloth. Burns away completely (mw-e03.5). Soft surface; a blade or arrowhead cuts it (cuttable), but it cannot hold a rope arrow's load. (mw-e03.31)
